hero.badge: For healthcare centers in Latin America
hero.description: Appointments that confirm themselves, patients who come back, and a practice that runs smoothly even when your front desk is busy. No paper, no spreadsheets, no calling one by one.

queEs.title: Your practice, more organized
queEs.subtitle: Without changing how you work. Without installing weird software. Without losing the personal touch with your patients.

cards.title: Appointments without calls
cards.text: Your patients book via WhatsApp, receive reminders and confirm with a tap. No more 'I forgot'.

cards.title: Patients who come back
cards.text: The system notifies you when someone needs a follow-up. Never miss a pending checkup again.

cards.title: Everything from your phone
cards.text: See your practice metrics from your phone. Know how many patients you saw, how many no-shows, and how much you billed.

comoFunciona.title: Three steps and you're ready
comoFunciona.subtitle: You don't need to be technical. In one week your practice is running with Pragma.

steps.title: We show you how it works
steps.text: Book a 20-minute demo. We'll show you the system with a practice like yours.

steps.title: We set it up for you
steps.text: We create your professional WhatsApp, connect your schedule, and get everything running. You don't touch a thing.

steps.title: You start noticing the difference
steps.text: Fewer no-shows, patients who come back on their own, and free time for what matters: caring.

casoReal.title: Results that speak for themselves
casoReal.subtitle: We're still working with our first centers. When we have concrete results, we'll share them here.
casoReal.placeholder: Want to be the first to get results with Pragma?

paraQuien.title: For practices like yours
paraQuien.subtitle: Dentists, dermatologists, clinics, multi-specialty centers. If you see patients, Pragma works for you.
